title: Rabbi Tachlifa, Father-in-Law of Rabbi Abbahu
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of Kohelet Rabbah, chapter 10, where Rabbi Abbahu speaks in his name. The statement is cited in Vayikra Rabbah 32:2 without the words “father-in-law of Rabbi Abbahu.” Hyman suggests that possibly he is Rabbi Tachlifa of Caesarea, as it is known that Rabbi Abbahu was from Caesarea.

notes.text: Kohelet Rabbah 10:20 gives Abbahu’s report in the name of his father-in-law. The parallel in Vayikra Rabbah 32:2 names Tachlifa directly. Hyman proposes the Caesarea identification.
